How Dynamic Presence Doubles Your Call Connect Rates
(Compared to Traditional Local Presence)
Automatically Choose the Right Local Number For Every Dial and Prospect

Get access to 350+ local numbers out of the box. Instead of simply calling from the last-selected number, Klenty identifies the area code of the prospect and chooses the local number most likely to be answered.
With other dialers, local presence is limited to ‘state-level’ or ‘coast-level’ at best. For instance, you get a number for ‘California’ or ‘the West Coast’ but not numbers for each local area.
Auto-Rotate Local Numbers Based On Prospect Location

Other dialers simply rotate numbers based on preset volume. Klenty intelligently rotates local numbers based on area code. This means every dial goes out from a familiar area code, but no number gets overused.
Local presence at every dialing speed
Whether you dial 5 lines simultaneously or one at a time in Power mode, Klenty works continuously in the background to make sure every dial to every prospect goes out with a local number.
